# Deviload 2.9.0

**Devil Music gets a new look and smoother listening.** Songs can blend into each other, albums play without gaps, and lyrics can show a translation under every line. The rest of Deviload now shares the same floating, translucent design.

- Crossfade between songs for up to 12 seconds. Tracks from the same album join without a pause.
- Set a sleep timer for 15 to 90 minutes, or stop after the current song. The music fades out over the last 30 seconds.
- Jump anywhere in a song almost instantly once it is playing. The first jump far ahead in a new song can still take a few seconds.
- Show a translation under each line of the lyrics, or read Korean, Japanese kana, Greek and Cyrillic lyrics in Latin letters. Translation is opt-in and sends the lyric lines to MyMemory; romanization works offline.
- Use keyboard shortcuts and right-click menus for songs, cards, the queue and playlists.

### Devil Music

Home, search and the library have a new layout. Search suggestions show covers, the kind of result and the artist. The library panel, the Now Playing panel and the player bar line up on one grid, and both side panels are translucent with matching corners. Shortcuts to Favorites, History and Downloads appear on Home only while the library panel is closed. The seven-day summary shows a small chart and your most played artist.

The full player has an immersive lyrics stage. Words fill as they are sung, background vocals appear separately and a second singer moves to the right. The player and its controls take their colour from the cover.

Liked songs, History and Downloads have Play and Shuffle buttons and show the total length. The phone remote is now called **Phone remote** and sits next to the mini-player and Listen together.

### Recommendations and playback

For you no longer reshuffles every time you return. Hiding a song removes it in place, and other uploads of the same song are not shown twice. On repeat favours what you played recently. Shuffle spreads out artists and avoids repeating the songs that ended the previous round. The next radio song is prepared reliably, so crossfades into it are not lost.

### Deviload

Sections, settings and Devil Convert use the same panels, pill buttons and quiet focus outlines as Devil Music. Option toggles such as Playlist and Subtitles show clearly when they are on.

Helper processes such as the music engine, yt-dlp and ffmpeg now close together with Deviload, even if the app is ended unexpectedly.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
